schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Uchha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana
schemes.eligibility: Minimum 60% marks in Class 12 board exams, family annual income below INR 2.5 Lakhs.
schemes.benefits: INR 500 per month (up to INR 5,000 annually) for up to 5 years.

schemes.name: Devnarayan Chhatra Scooty Vitran Evam Protsahan Rashi Yojana
schemes.eligibility: Girls passing Class 12 with at least 50% marks enrolled in state degree colleges.
schemes.benefits: Free motorized scooty or annual incentive payment up to graduation/post-graduation.

schemes.name: Rajasthan Free Tablet Yojana (Shiksha Vibhag)
schemes.eligibility: Top merit rank holders in Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE).
schemes.benefits: Free Smart Tablet with 3 years of complimentary internet connectivity.
schemes.application_portal: Direct departmental allocation via school headmaster/principal.
